composites.name: stage1_composite
composites.description: Stage 1 — collagen IV network staged protocol (assemble → relax → stretch → hold elastic → hold viscous). StagedStretchController drives the LAMMPS-backed CollagenNetworkProcess.

n_rods.description: Number of two-bead collagen IV rods.

box_xy.description: In-plane box size (units of the bead spacing a).

bending_k.description: Junction bending stiffness (0 = floppy central-force network).

composites.name: stage2_sweep
composites.description: Stage 2 — the collagen IV network on a growing (biaxially stretching) substrate; the σ(ε̇) sweep runs this composite at a range of strain rates with the crosslink chemistry on.

n_rods.description: Number of two-bead collagen IV rods.

box_xy.description: In-plane box size (units of the bead spacing a).

bending_k.description: Junction bending stiffness (0 = floppy central-force network).

composites.name: connectivity_sweep
composites.description: Rigidity (bm-v3) — the collagen IV network whose crosslink connectivity (z) is swept to test rigidity percolation.

n_rods.description: Number of two-bead collagen IV rods.

box_xy.description: In-plane box size (units of the bead spacing a).

bending_k.description: Junction bending stiffness (0 = floppy central-force network).

composites.name: bending_sweep
composites.description: FP1 (bm-v4) — the collagen IV network WITH junction bending (fix restrain pinned to each crosslink's as-formed angle). The athermal modulus is swept vs bending_k.

n_rods.description: Number of two-bead collagen IV rods.

box_xy.description: In-plane box size (units of the bead spacing a).

bending_k.description: Junction bending stiffness (fix restrain, as-formed angles); >0 rigidifies.

composites.name: porosity_bundling
composites.description: Stage 5 (bm-v5) — the assembled collagen IV network, read for its geometric readouts: pore-size distribution (porosity) and protomers-per-strand (bundling), against the measured BM comparators.

n_rods.description: Number of two-bead collagen IV rods.

box_xy.description: In-plane box size (units of the bead spacing a).

bending_k.description: Junction bending stiffness (0 = floppy central-force network).
